prompt:
Using the exact art style, materials, lighting and colours of the attached game UI mockup (carved dark rosewood frames, geometric window-lattice carving, brass corner fittings with small rivets, aged parchment insets), paint game UI ASSETS for that interface, not a screen.

Rules for every asset: seen perfectly flat and straight-on, no perspective, perfectly straight edges and right angles, mirror-symmetric left to right; evenly lit from the top left; no text, no letters, no numbers, no icons, no symbols, no logo, no watermark; no drop shadow cast onto the background. The background is one flat, pure chroma-key green (#00FF00) everywhere around the assets, with clear empty space between assets and around the canvas edge.

The assets:

Two assets side by side. Left: (1) one empty tooltip card, about 45 % of the canvas width, three units wide by two high: a plain aged-parchment centre, a thin dark-wood edge all round, and four small identical L-shaped brass corner brackets, mirror images of each other. Right: (2) one single large brass corner fitting shown alone, about 25 % of the canvas width: an L-shaped brass bracket with a small cloud-scroll flourish at its outer corner and two rivets, as fitted to the top-left corner of a window.
